title: 第七章 许大茂请客第八章 酒桌闲谈
slug: 诸天影视从四合院开始
content_zh:
从轧钢厂院儿里出来，许大茂美的不行，因为他以往跟傻柱交手的战绩，那叫一个惨不忍睹，他经常性的面对这个混不吝的时候没咒念，好多次在公众场合被傻柱给撅的卡巴卡巴的，有好几次，险些没挨揍。
许大茂对傻柱这个家伙恨得是咬牙切齿，要不是打不过他，许大茂恨不得把这个家伙给扒皮抽筋。
这次在厂长办公室的交锋，许大茂罕有的占据了有利态势，让这个轧钢厂一霸付出了惨痛的代价，此时的许大茂就好像三伏天喝了冰镇的燕京啤酒一样舒爽，只听他对着身边的妻子娄小娥开口说道：
“小娥，你回家掂对两个菜，我把叶晨叫过来喝两盅，要不是有他提醒，今儿个咱们能不能逮到幕后黑手还两说呢！”
娄小娥一听，顿时停住了脚步，怔怔的看着许大茂开口说道：
“什么？你是说今天的事情真的是傻柱指使的？”
“百分之一万是他干的，你没看到他一个劲儿的给秦淮茹家的小崽子出头吗？这个家伙是无利不起早的典型，真的要是与他无关，他早就事不关己高高挂起了，要知道这赔的可不是小数儿，都赶上他半个月的工资了，要不是他指使的，他才不会担这个干系呢，那不是有病吗？现在是事态逼得傻柱不得不掏这笔钱，要不然棒梗回到大院儿一说，他就真成了过街的老鼠了，人人喊打。”
许大茂阴笑了两声，开口说道。
娄小娥嘴巴微张，思忖了一会儿，开口说道：
“那成，家里还有几个鸡子儿，还有我早上排队捡的豆腐，我给你们煎个鸡蛋饼，炒个麻婆豆腐，再炒盘花生米，你们俩喝两盅，你回去把蜂窝炉点着，烧壶开水，把酒烫一烫，这样不容易做病。”
许大茂嘿嘿一笑，开口说道：
“花生米好，那玩意儿扛叨，下酒正好，还省钱。
鸡子儿就算了，那玩意儿稀罕，给我留两个明个一早蒸鸡蛋糕吃。”
娄小娥翻了个白眼儿，嫌弃的撇了一眼许大茂，开口说道：
“整天说这个能算计，那个能算计的，我看没谁比你更能算计。”
许大茂也没在意，说他算计，那也得分跟谁，在许大茂看来，跟个毛头小子，不算计着来，反而大大咧咧的款待他，那才是脑袋有包呢，自己又用不着他啥，请他喝顿酒也只是来分享自己的喜悦罢了。
要是换个年轻貌美的妹子，他舍得花钱着呢！
叶晨到了家，洗漱完毕，把火炕给点上了，上面坐了水壶，然后回了屋，坐在炕上翻看着自家老爷子留下来的工具书，都是些跟钳工有关的，比如《钳工工作法示范》之类的，既然已经来到了这个世界，就要既来之则安之，心里不能长草，在没有熟悉这个时代规则的时候，就像前世无脑网文里说的那样胡搞瞎搞，那是会出大事情的，先把本职工作做好了才是正经。
翻看了一会儿，叶晨感觉有点口渴，下了炕，来到了外屋地，这时候坐在炉子上的水已经烧开了，叶晨拿出了平时喝水的大茶缸子，根据记忆摸出了装茶叶的茶壶，从里面抓出了一把高碎，扔进了大茶缸子里，然后将刚烧好的开水倒了进去，顷刻间，一股子茶香在屋中飘荡。
所谓的高碎是一种茶叶末，在老北京时期深受买不起好茶又偏爱喝茶的贫苦人民的喜爱，其样子虽然不好看，但香味丝毫不差，在物质较匮乏的老北京却是一种高级茶，如今在北京的老字号茶叶店“张一元”

中仍有出售。
高碎是老北京的一种特有茶叶，又称为劳保茶，实际上是茶叶店筛茶时被舍弃的茶叶末，放在现在本是留之无用的东西，在老北京时期，却是买不起好茶，又偏爱喝茶的贫苦人民非常喜爱的茶饮。
高碎茶虽然失了形，样子不好看，但仍然是好茶，冲泡后香味丝毫不差，能享受到茶的清香。
在几十年前的老北京，物质比较匮乏，人们招待客人也会选用高碎茶，茶叶店出售高碎时也会谓之为高级茶叶末。
只不过这种茶冲过一水之后，茶叶味也会消失殆尽。
哪怕是到了现代，在前门大栅栏街的张一元总店，每年也会有老北京高碎出售，只不过是一年一次，六百个排队号码，刚一开门，就会被早就排在那里的市民抢购一空，有的在凌晨四五点钟就提前排在了那里，生怕去晚了买不到。
老北京人最“乐于”
排队。
上个世纪五六十年代，北京城里几乎无处不排队。
人们见队就排，往往是先排上队，再问排的是什么队？买什么的排队？
大到冬储大白菜，小到商店买豆腐，芝麻酱，高碎，几乎是无处不排。
哪怕是天桥大剧院跳芭蕾舞《红色娘子军》，小年轻的也大半夜的守在剧院门口，穿着大厚棉袄，仨俩一堆儿，等待着早上售票口一开门儿，一拥而上的上去买票。
叶晨泡好了茶叶末，回到了屋里，用小水杯盛出了一杯，然后坐在炕头，喝着茶，看着书，那叫一个惬意。
正在这时，门口传来了娄小娥的声音：
“叶晨，吃了没？没吃赶紧过来我屋，许大茂等着你喝酒呢！”
叶晨听到了声音，知道这两口子的事儿是忙活完了，下了地，趿拉上了板儿鞋，披上了棉袄，迎到了屋外，看到娄小娥，叶晨笑了笑，开口说道：
“嫂子，真不好意思，给您添麻烦了，还让您亲自过来一趟，辛苦您了。”
娄小娥也乐了，看了眼叶晨，开口说道：
“这有啥麻烦的，街坊四邻的，谁不麻烦谁啊，跟我走吧，嫂子掂对了俩菜，你跟你哥好好喝两盅。”
“得嘞！”

叶晨跟在了娄小娥的身后，直奔着许大茂家而去。
在四合院儿里，许大茂是正经八百的高收入人群，在那个物资匮乏的年代，许大茂的工作那是相当的吃香，油水颇丰，所以对于吃他一顿，叶晨是没有任何的心理负担的。

content_en:
Coming out of the yard of the steel rolling mill, Xu Damao was extremely beautiful, because his past record against Sha Zhu was terrible. He often did not curse when facing this gangster, and was poked by Sha Zhu many times in public. Several times, he almost didn't get beaten.
Xu Damao hated this guy Silly Zhu with all his teeth. If he couldn't beat him, Xu Damao would have wanted to peel off this guy's skin and cramps.
In this confrontation in the factory director's office, Xu Damao was in a rare advantageous situation, and the steel rolling mill tycoon paid a heavy price. At this time, Xu Damao felt as comfortable as drinking ice-cold Yanjing beer in the dog days of summer. He just heard him say to his wife Lou Xiao'e beside him:
"Xiao'e, you go home and prepare two dishes. I'll call Ye Chen over to drink two cups. If he hadn't reminded me, there's no telling whether we could have caught the mastermind behind this!"
When Lou Xiao'e heard this, she immediately stopped and looked at Xu Damao in a daze and said:
"What? Are you saying that what happened today was really instigated by Silly Zhu?"
"Ten thousand percent is his fault. Didn't you see that he kept trying to stand up for the Qin Huairu family's brats? This guy is a typical example of being unprofitable and unwilling to start early. If it really had nothing to do with him, he would have ignored it long ago. You must know that the compensation is not a small amount. It’s more than half a month’s salary. If he hadn’t instigated it, he wouldn’t have been responsible for it. Isn’t he sick? Now the situation has forced Si Zhu to pay for it. Otherwise, when Banggeng comes back to the compound, he will really become a rat on the street, and everyone will scream. "
Xu Damao laughed twice and said.
Lou Xiao'e opened her mouth slightly, thought for a while, and then said:
"That's it. I still have a few chickens at home, as well as the tofu I picked up in line in the morning. I'll fry you an egg pancake, stir-fry Mapo tofu, and stir-fry a plate of peanuts. You two will drink two cups. You go back and light the honeycomb stove, boil a kettle of water, and scald the wine. This will prevent you from getting sick."
Xu Damao chuckled and said:
“Peanuts are good, that thing is easy to carry, goes well with wine, and saves money.
Forget about the chicken eggs, they are rare, leave two for me to steam chicken cakes to eat tomorrow morning. "
Lou Xiao'e rolled her eyes, glanced at Xu Damao with disgust, and said:
"I keep saying that this person can calculate and that person can calculate. I don't think anyone can calculate more than you."
Xu Damao didn't care. If he said he was scheming, then he would have to deal with it. In Xu Damao's opinion, following a young boy, not scheming, but treating him carelessly, was a big deal. He didn't need him for anything. Inviting him to a drink was just to share his happiness.
If it were a young and beautiful girl, he would be willing to spend money!
Ye Chen arrived at home, washed up, lit the kang, and sat a kettle on it. Then he went back to the house, sat on the kang, and looked through the reference books left by his old man. They were all related to fitter, such as "Demonstration of Fitter Work Methods" and so on. Now that it has been When you have come to this world, you should take it as you come, and don't let grass grow in your heart. When you are not familiar with the rules of this era, if you mess around like the brainless Internet articles in previous lives say, big things will happen. Do your job well first before you are serious.
After looking through it for a while, Ye Chen felt a little thirsty, got off the kang, and went to the outhouse. At this time, the water sitting on the stove had boiled. Ye Chen took out the big teapot from which he usually drank water, and took out the teapot with tea leaves based on his memory. He grabbed a handful of tea leaves from it, threw it into the big teapot, and then poured the newly boiled water in. Suddenly, a scent of tea wafted in the room.
The so-called high breaking is a kind of tea powder. In the old Beijing period, it was deeply loved by the poor people who could not afford good tea but preferred to drink tea. Although it does not look good, the fragrance is not bad at all. In terms of material,Old Beijing, which was relatively scarce, had a high-end tea. Nowadays, it is sold in the time-honored tea shop "Zhang Yiyuan" in Beijing.
Still for sale in.
High broken tea is a kind of tea unique to old Beijing, also known as labor protection tea. It is actually the discarded tea leaves when sifting tea in tea shops. It is a useless thing now. In the old Beijing period, it was a very popular tea drink for the poor people who could not afford good tea and preferred to drink tea.
Although the high-broken tea has lost its shape and looks ugly, it is still good tea. After brewing, the aroma is not bad at all, and you can enjoy the fragrance of the tea.
In old Beijing a few decades ago, when materials were relatively scarce, people would also use high-breaking tea to entertain guests. When tea shops sold high-breaking tea, they would also call it high-grade tea leaves.
However, after this tea is washed with water, the tea flavor will disappear.
Even in modern times, at Zhang Yiyuan's main store on Dashilan Street in Qianmen, there is still old Beijing high-breakfast for sale every year, but it is only once a year. The 600 queue numbers will be snapped up by citizens who have been queuing there as soon as the door opens.
Old Beijingers are the most "happy"
Get in line.
In the 1950s and 1960s, there were queues almost everywhere in Beijing.
People queue up when they see a queue. They often get in line first and then ask what queue they are in. What to buy in line?
It ranges from Chinese cabbage stored in the winter to store-bought tofu, sesame paste, shredded pork, almost everywhere.
Even when the Tianqiao Grand Theater performs the ballet "Red Detachment of Women", young people are still waiting at the entrance of the theater in the middle of the night, wearing thick cotton-padded jackets, a group of three or two, waiting for the ticket office to open in the morning, and swarming up to buy tickets.
Ye Chen brewed the tea leaves, returned to the house, filled a cup with a small water cup, and then sat on the edge of the kang, drinking tea and reading a book. It was so comfortable.
At this moment, Lou Xiao'e's voice came from the door:
"Ye Chen, have you eaten? If not, come to my room quickly. Xu Damao is waiting for you to drink!"
Ye Chen heard the sound and knew that the couple had finished their work. He got down to the ground, put on his sneakers, put on his cotton-padded jacket, and went outside the house. When he saw Lou Xiao'e, Ye Chen smiled and said:
"Sister-in-law, I'm so sorry for causing you trouble. I even asked you to come over in person. Thank you for your hard work."
Lou Xiao'e was also happy, glanced at Ye Chen, and said:
"What's the trouble? Neighbors, who doesn't want to trouble anyone? Come with me. My sister-in-law has prepared two dishes. You and your brother can have a good drink."
"Okay!"
Ye Chen followed Lou Xiao'e and headed straight for Xu Damao's house.
In the courtyard, Xu Damao was a serious high-income earner. In that era when supplies were scarce, Xu Damao's job was quite popular and lucrative, so Ye Chen didn't have any psychological burden for eating from him.
